title: Below-one logarithm range reduction loses relative precision
classification: avoidable certificate refusal and precision/performance defect; no false certificate
baseline: Wolfram 15.0.0 reproduced; case A fails ResidualBracketOutsideInterval
repair: exact reciprocal reduction for 0<q<1 before dyadic range reduction
repair_status: executed in temporary standalone copies; not integrated; Mathics unrun
nearest_prior: C19/C20/P08 and wave-6 certificate precision reports; different operation and repair

title: Affine logarithm arguments are rounded before the logarithm resolves their small scale
classification: avoidable certificate refusal and precision/performance defect; no false certificate
baseline: Wolfram 15.0.0 reproduced; case B fails ResidualBracketOutsideInterval
repair: pass exact rational affine endpoints directly to certLog
repair_status: executed in temporary standalone copies; not integrated; Mathics unrun
nearest_prior: C20 already computes affine ranges exactly; this loss occurs at the subsequent rounding boundary
